verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an audit log that records who changed the cap table, what changed, and when. What it does show is a document trail: the data room automatically collects documents produced by changes, and grants are linked to their board consents. That is an adjacent feature that partly covers authorization, not a change log, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, every change to the cap table is captured in an audit log — who changed what, when, and under what authorization
